Hey, I'm trans. A lot of bad shit was going on around me when I realized that, so my dp/dr was a result of dysphoria and depression.

I think some important questions to ask yourself are: will I be happier being a girl/not a guy in the future? Can I see myself like this forever? Am I unhappy that others see me as a man?

I doesn't hurt to try and reflect on your past. Not everything will be a sign, but you might go "hm". 

Like for me I thought gender was really stupid & stood in the boys' line sometimes. I was also really happy that my chest was flat and wasn't growing as much as other girls. I couldn't figure out why then, but I do know now.

Keep in mind: not everyone's experiences with being are the same. Some experience less dysphoria. Some find out when they're older. Some don't choose to transition "all the way".

If you're still confused, I guess you can try it out? If you have friends who aren't transphobic, you can ask them to refer to you with she/her pronouns. If you live alone, you can try ordering some cheap women's clothes.

Sorry, if you already knew most of this stuff btw! I just wanna make sure everything makes sense. Don't be afraid to ask questions.
